title: ContactSearchResponse
description: A list of contacts that match the criteria specified in the request

data.description: The primary data of the document

meta.description: Non-standard meta information about the document

links.description: Links related to the primary data

id.description: The unique identifier for the resource
Unique ZoomInfo identifier for a company.

validDate.description: Date on which the contact record was last validated.

lastUpdatedDate.description: Date on which the contact record was last updated.

jobTitle.description: Contact job title at current place of employment.

contactAccuracyScore.description: This score indicates the likelihood that a contact is reachable and still employed by the company listed. Minimum score is 75 and maximum is 99.

managementLevel.description: Comma-separated list of contact management levels.

hasEmail.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has an email address for the contact.

hasSupplementalEmail.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a supplemental email address for the contact.

hasDirectPhone.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a direct phone number for the contact.

hasMobilePhone.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a mobile phone number for the contact.

hasCompanyIndustry.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has company industry for the contact.

hasCompanyPhone.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a company phone number for the contact.

hasCompanyStreet.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a street address for the contact.

hasCompanyState.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a state for the contact.

hasCompanyZipCode.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a zip code or postal code for the contact.

hasCompanyCountry.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has a country for the contact.

hasCompanyRevenue.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has company revenue data for the contact.

hasCompanyEmployeeCount.description: Indicates whether ZoomInfo has company headcount data for the contact.

directPhoneDoNotCall.description: Contact flagged with do not call for direct phone.

mobilePhoneDoNotCall.description: Contact flagged with do not call for mobile phone.

company.description: Contact's company data for search request.

first.description: A link to the first page of data

last.description: A link to the last page of data

prev.description: A link to the previous page of data

next.description: A link to the next page of data

Links.description: Helpful links for fetching different pages of data from the current result set. When using these links, please provide the exact same request body between requests

underManagement.description: Indicates whether record is under management within the contract period.

purchaseDate.description: Indicates when record was purchased if it is under management.

total.description: The total number of pages within the current result set

number.description: The current page number of the results

Page.description: Meta information related to the current page and total number of pages

totalResults.description: The total number of results based on the specified filters

page.description: Paging information for the current result set

ResultMeta.description: Metadata including paging information and the total number of records in the result set
